data.raw_text:
BK SNAPSHOT | Philippine troops stand atop the ASCOD Sabrah Light Tank ‘Captain Rommel B. Sandoval’ during Exercise Balikatan 40-2025 in Aparri, Cagayan — steel, forged in honor of a fearless warrior.

Known by his call sign “Daredevil,” Captain Sandoval led the 11th Scout Ranger Company with unmatched courage. In the 2017 Battle of Marawi, he was mortally wounded while shielding a wounded Ranger under heavy enemy fire—an act of ultimate sacrifice that earned him the Medal of Valor.

Today, the tank that bears his name rolls into battle drills with that same fearless spirit.

Photo by: Pfc Carmelotes PN(M) / PAOAFP
